@graph.name: Laser Skin Toning
@graph.description: Visit Derma Solutions for the Best Laser Toning Treatment in Bangalore. Safe, Affordable, and Advanced Laser treatments. Book your appointment today!
@graph.howPerformed: Before treatment, avoid sun exposure for at least 2 weeks and skip harsh exfoliants or chemical peels for a week. Arrive with clean, makeup-free skin on the day. After treatment, apply sunscreen daily, avoid hot showers or saunas for 24 hours, and use the gentle skincare products your dermatologist recommends.

acceptedAnswer.text: Most clients feel only mild warmth or a slight tingling during the procedure.
Typically, 4–6 sessions spaced 2–4 weeks apart are recommended, depending on your skin concern.
Laser toning can help improve stubborn pigmentation, including melasma, by breaking down excess melanin. Melasma often needs maintenance sessions.
Results are long-lasting, but maintenance sessions may be needed to address new pigmentation or maintain your skin's glow.
